description: Find backcountry and wilderness permits in the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia by name, park, trail or area, for hikes, Great Walks, climbs, river and canoe trips and overnight trips in national, state and provincial parks. Use this when someone asks how to get a permit or which permit a trip needs. Returns up to 10 permits with their PermitSnag page and whether PermitSnag scans them for cancellation openings. It does not check dates; use check_availability for that, and get_permit_details for the rules of one permit. An opening alert is set up with create_alert.

country.description: Optional country: US, CA (Canada), NZ (New Zealand) or AU (Australia). Omit to search all four.

query.description: A permit, trail, park or area name, like "Mount Whitney" or "Enchantments".

region.description: Optional province, state or territory outside the US, by name or abbreviation, like British Columbia, BC, Tasmania or NSW.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code, like CA for California. It limits the search to the US.

name: search_permits

outputSchema.description: Backcountry and wilderness permits in the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia that match the search.

country.description: The country filter, or null for all four.

region.description: The province, state or territory filter outside the US, as a slug, or null.

country.description: The country: US, CA (Canada), NZ (New Zealand) or AU (Australia).

region.description: Outside the US, the province, state or territory as a slug.

scanRoute.description: How PermitSnag reaches this permit for cancellation openings: direct, through a zone or starting area, through its entry points, or none.

scannable.description: True when PermitSnag scans this permit for cancellation openings. Whether an alert is on offer today is in get_permit_details.

usState.description: The two-letter US state; null outside the US.

state.description: The two-letter US state filter, or null.

title: Search backcountry and wilderness permits
